# Onhand

> Onhand is a free, open-source AI reading assistant for Chrome. Ask about the webpage, PDF or research paper you're reading, and Onhand highlights the passages that answer it right on the page, with a note in the margin beside each, and explains them in the side panel.

- Install: Chrome Web Store, https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ogjmncmkpgdkkcibdiacmagaehjohljb (works in Chrome and other Chromium browsers).
- Install on Firefox: Firefox Add-ons, https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/onhand-ai/ (voice isn't available in Firefox yet).
- Price: Onhand Free needs no account or API key and has a daily limit. For more, sign in with your ChatGPT plan or use your own OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or OpenRouter API key.
- Features: answers highlighted on the page with margin notes; a built-in PDF viewer for papers and textbooks; following a paper's citations; reading clearly related open tabs; Learning mode, which tutors with guiding questions, hints and quizzes tied to the page; flashcards and summaries on request; voice (needs an OpenAI API key); saved sessions you can reopen.
- Privacy: saved sessions and API keys stay in your browser. Onhand sends your question and the relevant page content to the AI provider you chose; with Onhand Free, that goes through Onhand's server to OpenAI.
- Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bdaY4gJIGsY (2:47): Onhand fact-checks a physics textbook's account of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge collapse and finds the 1991 paper on why textbooks get it wrong.
- Source code: https://github.com/Phineas1500/Onhand (Apache 2.0).
- Markdown: every page on this site is also available as Markdown. Request its usual URL with `Accept: text/markdown`, or swap `.html` for `.md` (the homepage is https://useonhand.com/index.md).
- Not to be confused with "OnHand", an unrelated new-tab bookmarks extension.

## Guides

- [Chat with a PDF in Chrome](https://useonhand.com/chat-with-pdf-chrome.html): ask questions about a PDF, online or on your computer, and see the exact passage highlighted, without uploading it.
- [AI research paper reader](https://useonhand.com/ai-research-paper-reader.html): explain papers, follow citations, compare papers in two tabs.
- [AI study tool that quizzes you](https://useonhand.com/ai-study-quiz-extension.html): Learning mode, quizzes on the page, flashcards and summaries.

## Comparisons

- [ChatPDF alternative](https://useonhand.com/chatpdf-alternative.html): free with no sign-up, and works on the webpage or PDF you're reading, including pages you're signed in to, instead of files you upload.
- [NotebookLM alternative](https://useonhand.com/notebooklm-alternative.html): works on the page you're reading instead of uploaded sources.
- [Sider alternative](https://useonhand.com/sider-alternative.html): focused on reading and studying.
- [SciSpace alternative](https://useonhand.com/scispace-alternative.html): any paper you open in Chrome, free and open source.
- [Sidenote alternative](https://useonhand.com/sidenote-alternative.html): highlights the passages as it answers, with margin notes.
